candidate_pair.overlap_rationale: The communities explicitly direct relevant questions to one another in their current rules. This supports a plausible shared audience but does not establish shared archived accounts or eligible writing capacity.
candidate_pair.registered_contamination_implication: The current unanswered-question cross-post route is a reason to retain exact/near-content and shared-thread audits, not evidence those audits will pass in the historical corpus.
candidate_pair.subject_relationship: General physics discussion versus physics questions and explanations. This pair broadens discussion purpose beyond academic careers or student-life communities, while remaining within one broad scientific subject.
